mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_trash (user_id, post_id, title, emotion, emotion_label, content, images, like_count, comment_count, deleted_by, deleted_by_name, original_create_time, deleted_time, expire_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{postId}, #{title}, #{emotion}, #{emotionLabel}, #{content}, #{images}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{deletedBy}, #{deletedByName}, #{originalCreateTime}, NOW(), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY))
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, post_id, title, emotion, emotion_label, content, images, like_count, comment_count, deleted_by, deleted_by_name, original_create_time, deleted_time, expire_time, appeal_status FROM post_trash WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND expire_time > NOW() ORDER BY deleted_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_trash WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
DELETE FROM post_trash WHERE expire_time <= NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_trash WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND expire_time > NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE post_trash SET appeal_status = #{appealStatus} WHERE post_id = #{postId}
